title: pi sandbox run config
description: Runtime knobs for scripts/pi-sandbox-docker.sh. Security-relevant fields (image, network, caps) are trusted-scope only: explicit --config file or ~/.config/anvil/sandbox.config.json. A project-local .pi/sandbox.config.json may only set max_containers. Validated fail-closed by scripts/pi-sandbox-config.mjs; unknown keys, looser network postures, and non-digest image references are refused.

image.description: Digest-pinned image reference for the sandbox container. Grammar: [registry-host[:port]/]name[:tag]@sha256:<64 hex> — private registries with ports (e.g. localhost:5000/anvil) and tag-plus-digest references are valid; the digest itself is REQUIRED (the ANVIL_SANDBOX_IMAGE env override remains the explicit-intent escape hatch for unpinned local builds). Example: ghcr.io/fakoli/anvil-pi-sandbox@sha256:<64 hex>.

network.description: Container network posture. Only "none" is implemented on the docker path today; a value may never be looser than the selected allowlist profile's network field. "inference" (egress to provider endpoints only) is reserved and rejected for now.

caps.description: Capability preset. "all-dropped" (default) passes --cap-drop ALL; "docker-default" omits it and keeps Docker's default capability set (no-new-privileges and the read-only rootfs still apply). This is a deliberate risk relaxation — prefer all-dropped.

max_containers.description: Refuse to launch when this many sandbox containers (label anvil.sandbox=pi-sandbox) are already running (counted via docker ps; advisory anti-fork guard, TOCTOU tolerated).
